title: WBI-warning broken items
description: Smart warnings about item durability, elytra, and firework counts with the "Repair" enchantment
body:
📋 Warning: Item Broken

Smart fashion that takes into account low item density, elite goods, and a large number of swordsmen.
✨ Main Features

🔧 Durability Warnings:

Notifications for low durability of tools, weapons, and armor

Automatic warning when switching to an item with durability ≤10

Special "Item Broken!" message when completely broken

Repair recommendation for items with the "Repair" enchantment

🪂 Elytra Monitoring:

Constant expert durability check in the inventory
Warnings before breakage during flight

🎆 Firework Monitoring:

Notification when quantity < 10
Warning after every 2 fireworks used
Perfect for long Elytra flights.

⚙️ Settings

Adjustable durability threshold (1-500)
Simple settings menu (damage key)
Russian and English language support

📦 Requirements

Matrix API
Minecraft 1.21.11+

🎯 Why this mod?

Unlike other durability mods, this mod:

Smartly detects when to switch items
Automatically tracks elites
Counts used fireworks
Provides repair recommendations
Minimal and unobtrusive interface
